column1: # window-seam-native — every place bt-app names a backend holder (App, WindowRuntime, Runtime,
# FolioApp, …) for the native backend, with why it cannot be written for the backend parameter
# Held by bt-source's window_seam test (every place is listed, every row is used) and, across
# commits, by scripts/ci/check-window-seam-native.ps1: **this list only shrinks** against the
# merge base. kind: method (an inherent block's method; owner the holder), trait (a trait block;
# owner the holder, name the trait's last segment), function (any other function; owner its
# impl's type or its module), type (a struct, enum or union whose fields hold one; owner its
# module), const (a const or static; owner its file).
